changelog.lead: A clear record of how the design of Forma UI evolves.
changelog.list.label: Versions
changelog.next.body: Compare the variants of each component and read its sizes, states and accessibility.
changelog.next.title: Explore the components
changelog.note.body: This history describes the design: its stages are not versions of the package, which has its own CHANGELOG.md.
changelog.note.label: About this history
changelog.v01.brand: In the dark theme, the primary action color is set to #3068ff so that white text on it passes AA, and the colors of its hover state and of links are added.
changelog.v01.muted: In the light theme, muted text on the hover surface is darkened to #616d81 so that it passes AA.
changelog.v01.progress: In the dark theme, the track of the progress bar gets its own color, so that the fill is at least 3:1 against it.
changelog.v01.title: Contrast adjustments in Resolve
changelog.v02.components: The first components of the library (Button, IconButton, Badge, Input, Field, Tooltip and Dialog) are extracted from Resolve with their accessibility behavior.
changelog.v02.title: Extraction from Resolve
changelog.v02.tokens: The 26 color tokens of each theme, with the type and spacing scales, are adopted from Resolve at commit c3f02f8.
changelog.v03.sizes: The Button reference shows the sizes 32, 40 and 48 px as proposed: Button keeps the height of Resolve, 42 px, and 44 px below 768 px of width.
changelog.v03.title: Proposed sizes stay proposals
changelog.v04.gettingStarted: Getting started in five steps, from the install command to a checked first screen.
changelog.v04.guides: Guides to the theme and to the accessibility obligations of the components, and this history.
changelog.v04.title: Clearer documentation
